name: Tales of Klodan
source:
Sent to Klodan as a royal envoy, the youngest prince of Fescilia expects diplomacy—not a land of fear and silence. With a trusted friend at his side, he is drawn into court intrigues and an encounter with a masked stranger. Six paths lie ahead, each leading to a different fate. Which will he choose? 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539600/Tales_of_Klodan/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
费西利亚最年轻的王子被派往克洛丹作为皇家特使，他期待的是外交——而不是一片恐惧和沉默的土地。在一位值得信赖的朋友的陪伴下，他卷入了宫廷阴谋，并遇到了一位蒙面陌生人。前方有六条路，每条路都通向不同的命运。他会选择哪个？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539600/Tales_of_Klodan/]Steam[/url]]
